title: How ChatGPT Actually Writes Its Answers

scenes.say: ChatGPT doesn't look up its answers. It writes them one tiny piece at a time. Here's how.
First, your message is chopped into tokens, small chunks of text.
Each token becomes a long list of numbers that stores its meaning.
Next comes attention. Every token looks at the others to see what matters. Here, blue connects strongly to sky.
This repeats through dozens of layers, each one building a deeper understanding.
Then it scores every possible next token, and picks a likely one.
It adds that token and runs the whole process again, word after word, until the answer is done.
It learned this by reading huge amounts of text and guessing the next word, over and over, tuning billions of numbers called parameters. Then human feedback taught it to be helpful.
So it's not magic. It's prediction, at a massive scale. Follow Chaos Creators for more.
